game-developer.message:
Mario moves by the NES game's own arithmetic; scrolling and flag scores as the original

- src/player.js: speed, friction, jump tiers, hold/fall forces, skid
  turnaround, run timer and gravity reproduced as the byte arithmetic of the
  public SMB1 disassembly (values and routine names in docs/rules.md)
- screen scrolls by Mario's movement with the original's 80/112 px rule
- flagpole score by Mario's height as the original's table; the pole is
  reachable past its base block
- star and invulnerability last as the original's interval timers
- title shows the controls under the menu
- tools/check11.mjs: 17 scripted checks of 1-1; tools/check-audio.mjs

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
